page_title: Delahaze Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the Delahaze marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-Dominant Hybrid
Genetics: Mango Haze × Lemon Skunk
Breeder: Paradise Seeds
THC Content: 18–24%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Terpinolene , Limonene , Myrcene
Primary Flavors: Citrus, Mango, Sweet, Herbal
Flowering Time (Indoor): 9–10 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Mid to Late October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 18–22 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Delahaze emerged during a period when cannabis breeders were refining the legendary Haze family into more practical hybrids for modern cultivation. Developed by Paradise Seeds, the strain combines the bright citrus energy of Lemon Skunk with the expansive sativa character of Mango Haze. The intention behind the cross was not only to create a flavorful marijuana cultivar but also to deliver a high that balances stimulation with clarity.

What makes this hybrid stand out is its combination of classic Haze-style mental effects and unusually strong production potential. Many sativa-dominant cannabis strains demand patience and long flowering cycles, yet this plant manages to produce generous harvests within a relatively manageable timeframe. For growers and enthusiasts alike, Delahaze represents a modern interpretation of tropical weed genetics refined through careful European breeding.
Genetics and Lineage

The lineage of Delahaze combines two well-known cannabis cultivars with distinct personalities: Mango Haze and Lemon Skunk. Each parent contributes important traits that shape the structure, aroma, and psychoactive character of the final hybrid.

Mango Haze forms the backbone of the strain’s sativa influence . This cultivar traces its roots to classic Haze genetics combined with fruity cannabis varieties that enhance terpene expression. Plants from this lineage often produce uplifting cerebral effects and distinctive tropical aromas reminiscent of ripe mango or citrus fruit.

Lemon Skunk contributes a complementary layer of brightness to the hybrid. Originating from stabilized Skunk genetics, Lemon Skunk is recognized for its pungent citrus fragrance and reliable growth patterns. This parent adds density to the flower structure and helps stabilize the plant’s flowering cycle.

When these two cannabis varieties are combined, the result is a cultivar that expresses both aromatic intensity and strong productivity. The plant often develops long branches typical of sativa marijuana plants while producing dense, resin-coated buds influenced by the Skunk lineage.

This genetic pairing also influences the terpene profile. Mango Haze contributes tropical fruit notes, while Lemon Skunk introduces bright citrus aromas. Together they create a layered sensory experience that stands out even among other Haze hybrids.
Effects and Experience

The psychoactive profile of Delahaze reflects the energetic nature of its sativa heritage. Shortly after consumption, many individuals notice a quick surge of mental stimulation accompanied by an uplift in mood. This early phase often brings a sense of enthusiasm that can make everyday activities feel more engaging.

As the high develops, the cerebral effects become more expansive. Ideas may flow freely and the mind can enter a creative rhythm. For individuals engaged in artistic work or brainstorming, this stage of the cannabis experience often feels particularly productive.

Despite the strong mental stimulation, the strain usually avoids the jittery edge sometimes associated with potent sativa weed. The influence of Lemon Skunk introduces a grounding element that helps maintain balance throughout the experience.

Physical effects tend to remain subtle but noticeable. Instead of deep body sedation, the plant produces a light sensation of physical ease that allows the user to stay active. This combination of stimulation and comfort often makes the strain suitable for daytime marijuana use. Toward the later stages of the experience, the energetic effects gradually mellow into a calm sense of clarity. The transition feels smooth rather than abrupt, leaving the mind relaxed while still alert.
Medical Benefits

The uplifting qualities of this cannabis cultivar may offer several potential benefits for individuals exploring therapeutic applications. Because the strain encourages mental stimulation, some patients find it helpful when dealing with fatigue or low motivation. The bright cerebral effects may also support individuals experiencing stress or emotional heaviness.

The shift toward mental clarity and positive mood can create a noticeable change in perspective during challenging days. Some patients seeking medical cannabis options prefer strains that allow them to remain active and focused. The balanced character of this hybrid may help maintain productivity while addressing mild discomfort or mental tension.

In addition, the subtle body relaxation accompanying the cerebral high may help ease minor muscle tightness without producing strong sedation. This makes the strain appealing for individuals who want symptom relief without sacrificing daytime functionality. As with any cannabis variety used for wellness purposes, individual responses can vary depending on dosage and personal tolerance.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Delahaze expresses a terpene profile that immediately reveals its fruity lineage. When the buds are broken apart, a burst of citrus fragrance often fills the air, accompanied by sweet tropical undertones. The dominant aroma frequently resembles lemon peel and fresh citrus zest. Beneath these bright notes lies a softer layer of mango-like sweetness that reflects the influence of Mango Haze.

As the cannabis flower is handled further, subtle herbal and earthy notes begin to appear. These deeper aromas provide balance to the otherwise vibrant citrus profile. The flavor experience mirrors the scent. On the inhale, users often notice bright citrus sweetness combined with faint tropical fruit. The exhale typically introduces mild herbal tones and a subtle skunky edge inherited from the Lemon Skunk parent.

The terpene profile commonly includes limonene, terpinolene, and myrcene. Limonene contributes the dominant citrus aroma, terpinolene adds herbal freshness associated with many Haze cannabis strains, and myrcene provides an earthy depth that rounds out the flavor.
Growing Information

Delahaze has gained popularity among cultivators largely because of its strong productivity and manageable flowering time for a sativa-dominant hybrid. The plant tends to grow vigorously, producing long branches that support multiple flowering sites.

Indoor growers who choose to grow marijuana often appreciate the plant’s ability to produce substantial yields within approximately nine to ten weeks of flowering. While the plant may stretch during early flowering, training techniques such as topping or screen-of-green setups help maintain an even canopy.

During the flowering stage, the plant develops elongated buds that gradually become coated in resin. Strong lighting and stable environmental conditions help maximize both yield and terpene development. Outdoor cultivation can produce particularly impressive results in warm climates with long growing seasons. Plants often reach significant heights when given sufficient space and sunlight.

Maintaining proper airflow is important because the plant can develop dense clusters of flowers along its branches. With attentive care, growers are rewarded with aromatic cannabis buds that showcase the strain’s citrus-forward terpene profile.
FAQ
Is Delahaze indica or sativa? Delahaze is a sativa-dominant cannabis hybrid created by crossing Mango Haze with Lemon Skunk.
Who bred Delahaze? The strain was developed by Paradise Seeds as part of their Haze-based breeding program.
How strong is Delahaze? THC levels typically range from 18% to 24%, producing an energetic and uplifting marijuana high.
What does Delahaze taste like? The flavor profile features bright citrus notes, tropical fruit sweetness, and subtle herbal undertones.
How long does Delahaze take to flower? Indoor flowering usually requires about 9–10 weeks, while outdoor harvests typically occur in early to mid-October.
Final Thoughts on Delahaze

Delahaze stands as a compelling example of how modern cannabis breeding can refine classic genetics without losing their original character. By combining Mango Haze with Lemon Skunk, Paradise Seeds created a weed strain that captures the cerebral excitement of Haze while delivering reliable harvests. The experience centers on mental clarity, creativity, and energetic mood elevation. Rather than overwhelming the body with sedation, the strain encourages engagement with the surrounding environment.

From a cultivation perspective, the plant rewards growers with impressive yields and vibrant terpene production. Its manageable flowering cycle makes it more accessible than many traditional Haze varieties. For cannabis enthusiasts seeking a citrus-forward sativa hybrid with strong production potential, Delahaze remains one of the standout marijuana strains to emerge from European breeding programs.
